title: The Sur Empire
definition: The Sur Empire (1540–1555) was an Afghan dynasty founded by Sher Shah Suri after defeating Humayun, representing a brief but transformative interregnum in Mughal rule characterized by centralized administrative, agrarian, and military reforms.
importanceInUpsc: It serves as the bridge between the Sultanate and Mughal administrative systems; Sher Shah's reforms (land revenue, currency, communication) became the blueprint for Akbar's governance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Sur Empire.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
